macros.name: CASE
macros.doc: Specifies a case statement with a case-item and a collection of when-statements.

macros.name: IF
macros.doc: Specifies an if statement with a condition and a collection of statements in the THEN and the ELSE part.

macros.name: LABEL
macros.doc: Specifies a label with a label-name of only a few letters.

macros.name: PROC
macros.doc: Specifies a special kind of action, a procedure call.

macros.name: REPEAT
macros.doc: Specifies a loop statement with a collection of statements and an end-condition.

macros.name: unitwidth
macros.doc: Specifies the minimum width of a unit.

macros.name: WHEN
macros.doc: Part of a case statement. Specifies a condition and a collection of statements.

macros.name: WHILE
macros.doc: Specifies a loop statement with a start-condition and a collection of statements.
